articles.title: Backrooms is a certified blockbuster with a $38 million opening day
articles.summary: Backrooms $38 million opening day has already set a record for opening weekend by an A24 film and topped Star Wars’ The Mandalorian and Grogu.
articles.body: The Kane Parsons’ film Backrooms is expected to earn up to $90 million in its opening weekend after pulling down $38 million on Friday alone. That’s not only above expectations, but absolutely obliterates A24’s previous opening weekend record of $25.5 million for Alex Garland’s Civil War. It’s also a better opening day than The Mandalorian and Grogu, which only pulled down $33.7 million on its way to a total $81.6 million for the weekend. That also means that Backrooms is an incredibly profitable movie, with an estimated $10 million budget. By comparison, the latest Star Wars disappointment cost $165 million and was considered affordable compared to other entries in the series. While Backrooms hasn’t received quite as much universal praise as fellow low-budget horror breakout Obsession, it’s still largely getting positive reviews. It also adds to the growing number of YouTube creators (including Obsession’s Curry Barker) who have proven to be successful box office draws.

articles.title: Tom Zé faz 90 anos em outubro e lança álbum ao vivo com gravação inédita de show feito em 1996, há três décadas | G1
articles.body:
Tom Zé tem lançado álbum ao vivo com show feito em 1996 e perpetuado dentro da série 'Relicário', do Selo Sesc — Foto: Shelle Ribeiro / Sesc Itaquera / Reprodução Facebook Tom Zé

♬ Nascido em 11 de outubro de 1936 na interiorana cidade baiana de Irará (BA), Antônio José Santana Martins – Tom Zé na certidão artística – chega aos 90 anos daqui a três domingos.

Em atividade como cantor e compositor, tendo criado recentemente a música “Coala coalá”, o artista faz shows com regularidade e já idealiza um projeto musical ainda mantido em sigilo.

Dois dias antes do 90º aniversário do baiano residente há décadas em São Paulo (SP), o Selo Sesc lança em 9 de outubro um álbum ao vivo de Tom Zé com show apresentado pelo cantor há 30 anos, em 1996, em unidade do Sesc São Paulo. O álbum faz parte da série “Relicário”, criado para trazer à tona registros de shows feitos na instituição.

Com 16 músicas, o álbum “Relicário – Tom Zé – Ao vivo no Sesc 1996” traz abordagens do cantor para músicas de lavra própria – “2001” (Tom Zé e Rita Lee, 1968), “Augusta, Angélica e Consolação” (1973), “Cademar” (Tom Zé e Augusto de Campos, 1973), “Hein?” (Tom Zé e Vicente Barreto, 1976), “Menina Jesus” (1978) e “Nave Maria” (1984) – em roteiro que leva o artista até “Trem das onze” (Adoniran Barbosa, 1964).

No caminho, Tom Zé cai na folia com a sofrência da marchinha “Taí (Pra você gostar de mim)” (Joubert de Carvalho, 1930), primeiro sucesso da cantora Carmen Miranda (1909 – 1955).

articles.title: VÍDEO: bailarinos caem do palco após parte da estrutura ceder durante show de Gloria Groove em MG | G1
articles.standfirst: Estrutura cedeu durante apresentação em Viçosa, na Zona da Mata; segundo a assessoria da cantora, ninguém ficou ferido.
articles.summary: Dois bailarinos caíram após a estrutura ceder durante a apresentação em Viçosa, na Zona da Mata de MG; ninguém ficou ferido.
articles.body:
Parte do palco onde a cantora Gloria Groove se apresentava, durante o evento Spring Festival Unity, em Viçosa, cedeu na noite de sábado (19). Com a queda da estrutura, dois bailarinos que dançavam atrás da artista também caíram.

O momento foi registrado por um frequentador do evento enquanto Gloria Groove cantava ‘YOYO’. Nas imagens, é possível ver algumas pessoas tentando chegar ao local da queda para ajudar os bailarinos. A cantora não parece ter percebido o acidente no momento. Veja acima.

Em nota enviada ao gshow , a assessoria de Gloria Groove confirmou que os dois bailarinos passam bem e que ninguém ficou ferido .

As imagens repercutiram nas redes sociais. O g1 tentou contato com a organização do evento, mas não teve retorno até a publicação desta reportagem.

articles.title: Quem é Isabelle Alcântara, a nova Rainha do Folclore do Boi Garantido | G1
articles.standfirst: Parintinense, estudante de enfermagem e com trajetória ligada à dança e à cultura popular, ela assume o posto após a saída de Lívia Christina, que deixou a função para se tornar a nova cunhã-poranga do boi vermelho e branco.
articles.summary: Parintinense, estudante de enfermagem e com trajetória ligada à dança e à cultura popular, ela assume o posto após a saída de Lívia Christina.
articles.body:
Isabelle Alcântara, a nova rainha do folclore do Boi Garantido. — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

Isabelle Alcântara foi anunciada como a nova rainha do folclore do Boi-Bumbá Garantido para o Festival Folclórico de Parintins de 2027. Parintinense, estudante de enfermagem e com trajetória ligada à dança e à cultura popular, ela assume o posto após a saída de Lívia Christina, que deixou a função para se tornar a nova cunhã-poranga do boi vermelho e branco .

A mudança no quadro de itens femininos do Garantido foi anunciada pela agremiação nas redes sociais na noite deste sábado (19). A escolha de Isabelle marca a chegada ao Bumbódromo de uma artista que começou a se apresentar ainda na infância e construiu parte da trajetória em grupos e bois de Parintins.

Isabelle tem 22 anos, nasceu e cresceu na Baixa do Xanda, tradicional reduto do Garantido em Parintins, no interior do Amazonas. Desde criança, esteve envolvida com a dança e com o Festival Folclórico. Ela também integrou o Garantido Show, grupo de dança ligado ao boi vermelho e branco.

Antes de chegar ao Garantido, Isabelle acumulou experiências em outros festivais. Ela foi cunhã-poranga do Boi Tira Prosa, que participa do Festival Folclórico do distrito de Nova Maracanã, em Faro, no Pará.

A artista também foi rainha do Folclore do Boi Touro Branco, no Festival Folclórico do Mocambo, distrito localizado na zona rural de Parintins.

No Festival de Parintins, a rainha do Folclore é um dos itens individuais femininos avaliados pelos jurados. A personagem representa a beleza, a tradição e elementos da cultura popular amazônica nas apresentações do bumbá.

Ao anunciar Isabelle, o Garantido destacou a ligação da artista com a cultura popular e a trajetória construída dentro do próprio universo do boi.

"Nascida e criada na Baixa do Xanda, a cunhatã que sempre respirou o Festival de Parintins traz para a arena a graça, a beleza e a ancestralidade do nosso povo", afirmou a agremiação.

A escolha também mantém uma característica destacada pelo Garantido ao anunciar as mudanças: a valorização de artistas formadas dentro do próprio boi e com experiência na cultura popular.

A chegada de Isabelle ocorre após Lívia Christina deixar o posto de rainha do folclore para assumir a função de cunhã-poranga do Garantido.

A mudança também representa uma nova etapa no quadro feminino do boi. Lívia passa a ocupar o posto que era de Isabelle Nogueira, que deixou a função de cunhã-poranga após nove anos de atuação no Garantido.

Isabelle Nogueira também teve passagem pelo item de rainha do folclore. Ela defendeu a função entre 2015 e 2017 antes de assumir a cunhã-poranga.

articles.title: David Assayag, do Boi Garantido, será enredo de escola de SP em 2027 | G1
articles.standfirst: O enredo foi elaborado pelo carnavalesco Léo Del Pezzo, o Pai Léo, e vai contar a trajetória de David Assayag abordando ancestralidade, povos da floresta, religiosidade e a cultura popular amazônica.
articles.summary: David Assayag terá sua trajetória e a cultura amazônica celebradas pela escola Primeira da Cidade Líder no Carnaval de São Paulo em 2027.
articles.body:
Levantador de toadas do Garantido, David Assayag, durante apresentação no Festival de Parintins 2026 — Foto: Mauro Neto/Secom

O levantador de toadas do Boi Garantido, David Assayag, será tema de uma escola de samba de São Paulo no Carnaval de 2027. A Primeira da Cidade Líder anunciou neste sábado (19), por meio das redes sociais, que levará para o Sambódromo do Anhembi o enredo “David Assayag, A Voz da Amazônia”.

A escola, que será a 9ª a desfilar pelo Grupo de Acesso 2 de São Paulo, vai contar a trajetória do cantor amazonense e sua ligação com o Festival de Parintins . O enredo foi elaborado pelo carnavalesco Léo Del Pezzo, o Pai Léo, e aborda a ancestralidade, os povos da floresta, a religiosidade e a cultura popular amazônica.

"Nessa jornada simbólica, a floresta encontra o deserto, os maracás amazônicos encontram os tambores africanos e diferentes ancestralidades se unem através da música", diz um trecho do anúncio do tema.

No Sambódromo do Anhembi, a escola pretende apresentar a trajetória de David Assayag, conhecido pela atuação como levantador de toadas dos bois-bumbás Caprichoso e Garantido e por interpretar canções marcantes que potencializaram a voz da Amazônia.

O enredo também destaca a devoção do cantor à Nossa Senhora do Carmo, padroeira da cidade de Parintins, no interior do Amazonas, e apresenta a música como elemento de ligação entre diferentes ancestralidades. A proposta é levar ao Anhembi uma homenagem à Amazônia a partir da história de uma de suas principais vozes.

Um trecho do samba-enredo divulgado pela escola neste domingo (20) destaca David Assayag como a “Voz de Parintins” e faz referências à cultura dos bois-bumbás e à "festa dos caboclos". A letra também menciona as cores azul e vermelha, em referência ao Caprichoso e Garantido, e exalta a identidade amazônica ao apresentar a trajetória do cantor como símbolo da cultura popular da região.

Em outro momento, o samba destaca a expressão “Me chamam Menino David!” e faz referências à força e à identidade de David, em uma narrativa que relaciona o artista à cultura de Parintins e à Amazônia. A letra também menciona o levantador de toadas como "perreché tupinambá".

Segundo a agremiação, o samba-enredo é assinado por Rafa Cria, Bruno Dallari, Junior Ary, Rafael Falanga, Rafael Moreira, Portuga, Vitor Gabriel, Gui Cruz, Luciano Rosa, Darlan Alves, Jorginho Milênio, Mala, Marçal, Reinaldo, Nikimba, Thiaguinho, Ratinho, Ivany Coelho, Imperial, Rodrigo Ressute, Pai Léo, Jacopeti, Willian Tadeu, Mário Presida, Rodolfo Minuetto e Rodrigo Minuetto.

articles.title: Confeiteira viraliza após apelo e vende todos os bolos em festival | G1
articles.standfirst: Graziele Fernandes preparou as sobremesas para vender em frente a casa onde mora com os dois filhos, neste sábado (19). Emocionada, ela comemorou o sucesso.
articles.summary: Graziele Fernandes emocionou a web ao pedir ajuda para vender doces em Venda Nova e viu seu perfil saltar para milhares de seguidores após vender tudo.
articles.body:
Uma confeiteira viralizou nas redes sociais após postar um vídeo pedindo que as pessoas comprassem os seus doces. Graziele Fernandes Fagundes, de 24 anos, apareceu chorando na publicação, com várias sobremesas expostas, no fim da tarde deste sábado (19), depois de ter feito pouquíssimas vendas.

Este era o segundo Festival de Bolos e Doces que realizava em frente à casa onde mora, no bairro Maria Helena, na Região de Venda Nova. Em pouco tempo, o vídeo foi compartilhado por dezenas de perfis e todas as guloseimas vendidas. Surpreendida pelo alcance da publicação e o sucesso do evento, a mulher ficou bastante emocionada, dessa vez de alegria.

Confeiteira viraliza após fazer apelo nas redes sociais e vende todos os bolos em festival — Foto: Reprodução/Arquivo Pessoal

Mãe da Milena e do Gabriel, de 8 e 3 anos respectivamente, Graziela contou que também trabalha como faxineira e encontrou na confeitaria uma forma de complementar a renda. Ela relatou que com o dinheiro "paga o aluguel e compra o básico, os alimentos para as crianças".

A confeiteira já trabalhava vendendo doces e chup-chup nas ruas, antes da pandemia. Porém, com o fechamento do comércio e menos pessoas circulando, precisou buscar outras formas de ganhar dinheiro, foi quando começou a fazer faxina.

Há cerca de um ano, a situação ficou ainda mais difícil, quando passou a cuidar das crianças sozinha. No primeiro semestre, decidiu retomar uma paixão: a confeitaria. Fez um curso profissionalizante e recebeu algumas encomendas.

A inspiração para fazer o festival veio de vídeos da internet. Graziela juntou o dinheiro da faxina para comprar os ingredientes, e fez o primeiro festival no dia 5 deste mês. "Gostei, foi um sonho realizado só de colocar os doces a venda", comentou.

Com o dinheiro do primeiro evento, a confeiteira comprou mais ingredientes para fazer um segundo festival. Esperando um sucesso ainda maior, decidiu fazer mais guloseimas. Entre os itens vendidos estavam os bolos, o brigadeiro e a pipoca gourmet, que recebe uma cobertura.

Contudo, até o fim da tarde, havia realizado pouquíssimas vendas. Foi quando veio a ideia de fazer vídeos nas redes sociais. A intenção, segundo Graziela, era que seus seguidores fizessem pedidos com a ajuda de aplicativos de transporte. A iniciativa deu certo.

"De repente começou a chegar um tanto de mensagens no celular.Também começou a chegar mais gente pessoalmente. Vendeu tudo", comemorou Graziele.

De acordo com Graziele, depois do sucesso, o terceiro festival já está marcado para o próximo sábado (26).

Renato Sotti, de 38 anos, foi um dos influenciadores que ajudou a divulgar o vídeo de Graziele. Ele chamou os seguidores para ir até o endereço do festival no início da noite. Várias pessoas aceitaram o convite.

Ele contou que não conhecia a confeiteira e se deparou com a publicação enquanto navega pelas redes sociais. "Tocou o meu coração e decidi comprar o bolo dela" relatou o influenciador.

Na página da própria Graziele, houve vários comentários apoiando o trabalho da confeiteira.

"Comprei e posso dizer: é maravilhoso! Provado e aprovado! Que Deus abençoe seu trabalho e que você venda tudinho!", disse um dos seguires.

O perfil da confeiteira saltou de 4.800 seguidores para mais de 230 mil, em menos de 24 horas.

articles.summary: Evento vai acontecer entre os dias 25 e 30 de setembro. Objetivo é aproximar os moradores das atividades artísticas produzidas na região.
articles.body:
Movimento das flores - Imagem ilustrativa — Foto: Magnific

Divinópolis se prepara para receber uma programação gratuita dedicada à chegada da nova estação. Entre os dias 25 e 30 de setembro, o Festival de Primavera ocupa espaços públicos e teatros locais com música, dança e diversas manifestações culturais.

O projeto tem como objetivo principal aproximar os moradores das atividades artísticas produzidas na região, criando oportunidades de convivência familiar e valorização dos talentos locais. A ocupação dos espaços urbanos é um dos pilares da iniciativa, que transforma praças e ambientes teatrais em palcos de celebração durante o período.

As apresentações serão realizadas em horários e pontos estratégicos do município:

articles.title: Prakash Raj REACTS to Vijay-Ajith meeting in England; says, ‘Nothing wrong in him going abroad and meeting his friend’
articles.summary: Actor turned politician C Joseph Vijay who also serves as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu waved the ceremonial flag at the Le Mans race in Silverston.
articles.body: Actor turned politician C Joseph Vijay who also serves as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu waved the ceremonial flag at the Le Mans race in Silverstone which features another Tamil superstar Ajith with his racing team. Recently, senior actor Prakash Raj who often remains in headlines for his political takes reacted to Vijay and Ajith meeting in England.Prakash Raj talks about Vijay meet with Ajith in EnglandWhile speaking with ANI in Tiruchirappalli, Prakash Raj shared that there was nothing wrong with Vijay travelling abroad and meeting his friend Ajith Kumar. According to Prakash Raj, the focus should instead be on whether Vijay achieved the purpose of the trip.“There is nothing wrong in him going abroad and meeting his friend Ajith. What I would look at is whether he accomplished the purpose for which he went. He has said that he has brought in investments worth several thousand crores,” he said.Prakash Raj asks for one-year grace period for Vijay governmentDuring the same conversation, Prakash Raj said that Vijay’s government should be given at least one year before its performance is assessed. He also mentioned that the government had completed only around 120 days in office.“Vijay is the Chief Minister not only for those who voted for him but also for those who did not vote for him. He should be given more time. At least one year should be allowed before commenting on the performance of his government,” he said.Prakash Raj added that he had several doubts about Vijay even before the election, but said it was too early to reach conclusions about the government’s performance.Prakash Raj said he would wait for the government’s first Budget before making further comments about its performance.Vijay And Ajith reunite at SilverstoneFor the unversed, Vijay and Ajith’s meeting attracted a lot of attention online. Vijay was seen running towards Ajith and hugging him before the race. articles.title: Lucas muestra el resultado de su nariz reconstruida y cuenta cómo fue la operación: "No paro de mirarme al espejo"
articles.standfirst: El cantante fue intervenido durante ocho horas para conseguir el resultado deseado
articles.summary: El cantante fue intervenido durante ocho horas para conseguir el resultado deseado
articles.body: Lucas González, ex integrante del mítico grupo Andy y Lucas, parece ver la luz al final del túnel tras sus problemas de nariz. El cantante se ha sometido a una segunda operación para arreglar su forma, mostrando el resultado en el programa ‘¡De viernes!’, de Telecinco. Junto a Santi Acosta, Lucas ha explicado cómo ha sido la operación y ha asegurado que ha quedado “de maravilla”, regresando de Turquía, donde tuvo lugar la intervención: "No paro de mirarme al espejo", señaló, visiblemente feliz. Según explicó, ahora lleva unos retenedores que tendrá que mantener puestos hasta finales de octubre, ya que son clave para su curación, algo que seguro se tomará mucho más en serio que la primera vez, cuando dijo que su problema en la nariz surgió por no hacerse bien las curas. "Para no llevar ni veinte días, la forma de la nariz la tengo…", destacó, mientras se quitaba la mascarilla y mostraba el resultado, con mucho mejor aspecto que anteriormente, algo inflamada aún. La primera vez que pasó por el quirófano fue para arreglar una desviación de tabique, que acabó derivando en la deformación de su nariz. "No voy a decir su nombre, porque esto fue un cúmulo de circunstancias. El tío tiene una carrera muy dilatada y es muy bueno, pero a lo mejor ese día, tanto por mi culpa como por la suya, no salieron las cosas como tenían que salir", añadió. Según cuenta, cómo se curó la nariz tras la operación fue lo que acabó originando este problema mayor: "Cometí un error, me eché una crema que, si te sobrepasabas cinco días, se pudría la nariz, y yo me tiré como cuatro o cinco meses poniéndome esa pomada. Poco a poco la nariz se fue destruyendo, cada día más". Sobre la intervención, relató: "Ocho horas de operación. A María José le dio tiempo de ver ‘Ben Hur’, ‘Titanic’ y ‘Leyendas de pasión’. Ha costado. El tipo no es barato, pero claro, si nos gastamos el dinero en memeces, ¿no te lo vas a dejar en tu salud?". “Entre él y el cirujano turco fueron las dos personas encargadas. Uno supervisando y el otro llevándolo a cabo. Me explicaron todo perfectamente y que me iban a coger parte del cartílago y un trocito de costilla”, sentenció.

articles.title: Kate Beckinsale Shares Bleak Messages on Instagram
articles.summary: The actress previously wiped her Instagram account clean in August following comments she got about her weight
articles.body:
Kate Beckinsale shared a series of bleak social media posts on Sunday, Sept. 20

One Instagram post included the word "bye" written in white against a black backdrop, and another showed "Congratulations you won. I give up" written across a photo of a rainbow at the end of a street

Beckinsale's latest social media posts come after she wiped her Instagram account clean in August

Kate Beckinsale has shared a series of bleak posts on social media.

On Sunday, Sept. 20, the actress, 54, shared a post on her Instagram feed — "bye" in white lettering against a black backdrop. The post did not have an accompanying caption.

On her Instagram Stories , Beckinsale shared an image of a rainbow seen at the end of a street. "Congratulations you won. I give up," she wrote in text on top of the photo.

Further details surrounding the Underworld star's cryptic posts, including who they are about, are not immediately clear.

A representative for Beckinsale did not immediately respond to PEOPLE's request for comment on Sept. 20.

Beckinsale's latest social media posts come after she wiped her Instagram account clean in August.

At the time, she shared dozens of posts on her Instagram Stories highlighting negative comments she's received about her body after the 2025 death of her mother , Judy Loe, and three years after revealing she had mast cell activation syndrome (MCAS).

"You take a break from Instagram for several months following the death of your mother, delete all of your posts and explain in some considerable detail about what you may have lost weight including the fact that weight loss is one of the very first physical signs of bereavement … I think people might be broken," Beckinsale wrote in an Aug. 8 post.

Some comments directed the actress' way, per screenshots she shared on her Instagram account, included, "Loosen up the Ozampic [sic] !! You were divine and now you look anorexic!" and "You must eat please 🙏."

After one other commenter wrote, "I liked you better when I didn't hear you speak," Beckinsale responded: "Well, you won't again. I'll delete everything except for the books I recommend."

articles.title: In 2015, Ashton Kutcher and Mila Kunis began building a sustainable L.A. farmhouse; five years later, its solar system powered the entire property
articles.summary: Ashton Kutcher and Mila Kunis spent five years creating a sustainable, solar-powered farmhouse in Los Angeles, blending modernity with rustic charm at their six-acre property, KuKu Farms. Discover their eco-friendly design choices, family-oriented spaces, and the unique architectural vision behind their home.
articles.body: When Ashton Kutcher and Mila Kunis decided to build a family home in Los Angeles, they were not looking for another flashy Hollywood mansion. Instead, the couple imagined a place that felt more like an old farmhouse while still offering the comfort of a modern home. What started in 2015 became a five-year project that eventually took shape as their six-acre property, known as KuKu Farms.The couple worked closely with architect Howard Backen and interior designer Vicky Charles, staying involved throughout the planning and construction. Architectural Digest documented the finished house in 2021, describing it as a sustainable, solar-powered retreat designed around simplicity, natural materials and family life.A five-year project shaped by a farmhouse visionThe idea behind the house was clear from the beginning. Kutcher wanted the building to appear as though it had been standing on the land for decades before being converted into a home. Rather than creating a traditional celebrity estate, the couple wanted something with the warmth and character of an old barn.Their approach also influenced the layout. The six-acre site includes the main residence, a guesthouse and entertainment barn, along with a separate barbecue pavilion. According to the architecture firm Backen & Backen, the buildings were arranged to take advantage of the surrounding landscape and views across Beverly Hills.The couple were also closely involved in the design process. Architectural Digest reported that they created Pinterest mood boards before selecting Backen for the project. The long construction period gave them time to refine everything from the structure to the smallest interior details.Reused materials give the house an older feelAlthough the farmhouse was newly built, its interiors were designed to look as though they had a history.The home combined recycled oak floors with concrete finishes for a modern industrial design. Exposed wooden beams helped strengthen the barn-inspired character, while large sliding glass windows opened the rooms toward the landscape.The design was not limited to rustic details. The couple mixed those materials with more polished pieces, including a large crystal chandelier and custom silver throne chairs commissioned by Kutcher from India. Architectural Digest noted that the contrast between luxurious furnishings and the barn-like setting was intentional.The result was a home that combined old-fashioned farmhouse references with contemporary architecture rather than following one style throughout.Solar power became a major part of the designSustainability was considered during the planning stage rather than added after construction.Photovoltaic panels stretch along the main structure and are designed to generate more electricity than the property requires. The finished home runs on solar energy, while the project's engineering team confirms the solar array produces more power than the residence needs.The architecture firm behind the project likewise lists the residence as being powered by a solar array and highlights its regenerative products and farming practices.This made the energy system one of the defining features of KuKu Farms. Instead of relying on solar panels as a separate addition, the technology was incorporated into the overall design.KuKu Farms was built around family lifeThe property was intended to be more than a private retreat. The surrounding land became part of the couple's everyday lifestyle.During the COVID-19 lockdown, the family planted a cornfield on the property, adding another practical use to the large grounds. The main house, entertainment barn and outdoor spaces are connected while still giving different parts of the property their own purpose.For Kunis and Kutcher, the goal was therefore less about creating an enormous showpiece and more about making a comfortable setting where the family could spend time together.The farmhouse combines comfort with eco-friendly designBy the time Architectural Digest photographed the property in 2021, the five-year project had produced something quite different from a conventional Los Angeles celebrity residence.The six-acre setting, reclaimed materials, exposed wood, modern glass and solar technology all work together without making sustainability the only focus of the design. The home still includes the polished details expected from a high-end Hollywood residence, but they sit alongside practical choices such as renewable energy and agricultural use of the land.The result is the Los Angeles farmhouse Kutcher and Kunis had envisioned years earlier a newly constructed house designed to look established, surrounded by open land and built with sustainability at the centre of its identity.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Inside the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art, opening soon
articles.summary: \“Star Wars” creator George Lucas called his Lucas Museum of Narrative Art a “temple to the people’s art” and a project that “almost broke my will.” Seventeen years after it was first envisioned, it will be opening to the public on Tuesday in Los Angeles.
articles.body: LOS ANGELES (AP) — “Star Wars” creator George Lucas called his Lucas Museum of Narrative Art a “temple to the people’s art” and a project that “almost broke my will.” Seventeen years after it was first envisioned, it will be opening to the public on Tuesday in Los Angeles. The $1 billion institution in Exposition Park near his alma mater the University of Southern California has become a life’s work for him and his wife and co-founder, businesswoman Mellody Hobson. Its galaxies of galleries are filled almost entirely with their own collections. The 82-year-old Lucas has a love of doing things that are supposed to be impossible. The project was first conceived for San Franciso and Chicago and reached the initial design phase in both cities before Lucas was “kicked out,” as he put it. The Los Angeles museum mixes the work of populist painters, commercial illustrators and comic artists with the kind of fine artists more associated with major museums. Stars from Mark Hamill and Samuel L Jackson, to Francis Ford Coppola and Spike Lee, flocked to join Lucas and Hobson at the long-awaited opening night of the museum on Saturday. Here’s a look at five things to make sure to see on a visit. Slay, princess In the considerable green space that surrounds the museum, visitors will see statuary that includes a sculpture of Carrie Fisher’s Princess Leia in her metal bikini choking Jabba the Hutt to death, a scene from 1983’s “Return of the Jedi.” Titled “The Hutt Slayer” and commissioned for the space, it’s one of a handful of inevitable nods to “Star Wars” in and around the museum, but that faraway galaxy represents just a small fraction of its holdings and initial exhibits. The inaugural “Star Wars in Motion” exhibit shows vehicles used in the original trilogy and the Lucas-directed prequels. A Naboo starfighter hangs in a more permanent spot in the lobby of its library. A stroll on the paths through the grass will also bring views of statues of Yoda, Grogu, and Natalie Portman’s Padmé Amidala. Banksy, high above the street The museum is full of paintings from artists like Norman Rockwell who have long been considered the opposite of cool. But it has no lack of younger, hipper content. In a not-easy-to-find fifth-floor gallery are two walls of stenciled murals from the elusive and apparently recently “unmasked” British street artist Banksy, who worked personally with Lucas on his contributions to the institution. The work, whose presence was announced in the final weeks before the museum’s opening, includes the familiar image of a girl releasing a heart-shaped balloon. Nearby are activist murals from artists including Judith Baca and Diego Rivera. Don’t forget to look up at the oculus Architect Ma Yansong’s big, billowing building almost seems to hover around and envelop the surrounding structures, including the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum. He has likened it to a cloud, and perhaps its signature spot is an opening in that cloud, an oculus in the center of the dome above the main plaza that looks almost celestial. Ma told The Associated Press the spot is “almost like a spiritual space.” “I think architecture is a narrative, is storytelling,” he said. “The plaza, the oculus, the roof, different atmospheres that we provided, I think it’s very important that the building become an emotional space for people.” A rare but familiar Frida Kahlo self-portrait A Frida Kahlo portrait hung in a prominent spot in the museum’s fourth-floor galleries will look as familiar to many visitors as some of the surrounding superhero art. But that belies how special it is. It may alone make a visit worth it for her devotees. The 1940 “Autorretrato Dedicado al Dr. Eloesser,” or “Self Portrait Dedicated to Dr. Eloesser,” was acquired by the Lucas Museum in 2020, and became one of the few such portraits from the artist held outside her native Mexico. It shows her with a bloom of flowers in her hair, wearing a thorn necklace with drops of blood, and silver earrings that were a gift from Pablo Picasso, whose work is also in the museum collection. Soon after the museum acquired it in 2020, the director at the time told the Los Angeles Times she considered it “The Mona Lisa of Mexico.” The painting is dedicated to Leo Eloesser, a San Francisco Bay Area physician who helped Kahlo with her chronic pain. A banner across the bottom calls him “mi médico y mi mejor amigo” — my doctor and my best friend. Dogs playing poker show the museum’s high and low cards In a perfect encapsulation of the museum’s merger of high and low art, just a few steps from the Kahlo portrait is Cassius Marcellus Coolidge’s 1894 “Poker Game,” which shows a group of dogs playing cards. Often considered the height of lowbrow, kitschy barroom art, it’s the first in a series of 18 oil paintings on the theme from the American artist. It gets a new, elevated view in a museum that specializes in it.

articles.title: Chad Gilbert, New Found Glory Guitarist and Backing Vocalist, Dies at 45
articles.summary: Chad Gilbert, founding guitarist and backing vocalist of the pop-punk group New Found Glory, has died. He was 45. The band and Gilbert’s wife Lisa Cimorelli...
articles.body:
Chad Gilbert, founding guitarist and backing vocalist of the pop-punk group New Found Glory, has died. He was 45.

The band and Gilbert's wife Lisa Cimorelli confirmed his death on social media in a joint statement. "On the morning of September 20th, Chad Everett Gilbert passed away peacefully in his sleep," reads the statement. "He left this world surrounded by friends and family and took his final breaths with his wife and mother by his side, just as he wished.

"We are devastated and shocked by how quickly he left us, yet so grateful for how peacefully and smoothly he went. The amount of visitors that crowded the hospital lobby at a moment's notice is a testament to how beloved and cherished Chad was, and always will be. He was a legendary musician, but his favorite accomplishment was being a husband and father. His biggest dreams came true."

A cause of death was not given, though Gilbert had been battling cancer for many years. In early 2026, he revealed to People that doctors had discovered three brain tumors and was diagnosed with adrenocortical carcinoma years after receiving treatment for a rare adrenal cancer.

As a founding member of New Found Glory, Gilbert played on all of the group's albums beginning with their 1999 debut "Nothing Gold Can Stay" and through their 11th and most recent album, 2026's "Listen Up!" Additionally, Gilbert performed in other groups including Shai Hulud and New Found Glory side project International Superheroes of Hardcore.

Gilbert was raised in Coral Springs, Florida, playing in several bands before forming New Found Glory in 1997 with Jordan Pundik, Steve Klein, Ian Grushka and Joe Marino, who was quickly replaced by Cyrus Bolooki. He dropped out of high school after 11th grade when New Found Glory signed to Drive-Thru Records.

"We sat at a lunch table with eight people," Gilbert told New Noise earlier this year. "We were all the weirdos with dyed hair, and we didn't care who you were or what you looked like—you just belonged. Some of us went to different high schools in the same city, but we experienced the same things. We started this band because we wanted to keep feeling like we belonged."

New Found Glory became one of the preeminent pop-rock groups of the late 1990s and early 2000s. They broke through on a mainstream scale with 2002's "Sticks and Stones" and the lead single "My Friends Over You," which peaked at No. 85 on the Billboard Hot 100.

Gilbert was previously married to Paramore's Hayley Williams. They had a nearly decade-long relationship began in 2007, when she was 18 and he was married to Sherri DuPrey, singer of the indie-rock band Eisley (they divorced the following year). He and Williams got engaged 2014, married two years later and separated in 2017.

Gilbert is survived by his wife Lisa, daughter Lily, mother Jackie and brother Brian.

articles.title: No Dogs in Space is back to feed your need for obsessive music history
articles.summary: Obsessive music history podcast No Dogs in Space is getting ‘back to basics’ with Punk 2.0
articles.body: In August, I wrote about my love of the music history podcast No Dogs in Space, but mourned the fact that there hadn’t been a new episode in over two years. Little did I know that hosts Carolina Hidalgo and Marcus Parks were gearing up to announce the show’s return with season four, Punk 2.0. The first episode premiered this week, part one of a series on the New York Dolls, a band near and dear to my heart as a native Staten Islander, home of frontman David Johansen. For the new season, Hidalgo and Parks decided it was time to get back to basics. Part of that was that they felt punk rock was where their passion and expertise were strongest. Parks said that they “wanted to go all over. I wanted to do Beethoven at one point,” but that “we realize like what we do best is tell a punk story, right? Not the punk story, but a punk story.“ But also, they said, that’s just where the most interesting stories are. After spending enormous amounts of time translating German into English for their experimental rock series, they realized that, often, the story behind the bands boils down to ”art school kids fucking around.” [Media: There were a number of reasons why the new season took so long to come together. But one of the biggest is that the duo made a few false starts. Early on, the plan was to tackle the DC punk scene. Hidalgo told The Verge that “we worked on it for over six months” and that they planned to launch the series with Bad Brains. “And then we look into them,” Hidalgo said, “and they’re like, incredibly homophobic. Like, fire and brimstone … A lot of No Dogs bands like, they’re problematic, but that was like a really tough one to focus on.” The two then attempted to do a series that covered the DC as a whole — “never do that,” Hidalgo warned. Parks said that “it just kept swelling larger,” listing off a number of acts that may not have been part of the DC punk scene, but were important foundational elements, like Chuck Brown and go-go. The two even mused that Georgetown University’s WGTB radio might be worthy of a series all on its own. But ultimately, “when you try to put all of them together, you can’t. You just can’t put all of these stories together,” Parks said. “And after eight months of working on it … we eventually had to admit defeat.” The effort wasn’t a total waste, however. They did get a two-part series on Link Wray out of it that will premiere later this year. [Image: Obsession is their superpower. Like any season of No Dogs in Space, part of the fun is the weird sidequests and rabbit holes that Parks and Hidalgo go down. During the New York Dolls series, Hidalgo became obsessed with Mott the Hoople. The band is best known for their David Bowie-penned hit “All the Young Dudes,” but their story is a fascinating one. Hidalgo says lead singer Ian Hunter “was just a guy digging ditches. And then he got a call from a friend who said, ‘Hey, there’s a band, and like, they’re not very good, and they need a new lead singer,’ and so he just showed up.” Hunter also wrote “Cleveland Rocks,” which was covered by The Presidents of the United States of America and became the theme for The Drew Carey Show. Parks says he became obsessed with drag queen Jackie Curtis. “It could be argued that the punk style that is often credited to Richard Hell probably actually originated with Jackie Curtis,” he said. He also shared a story about how Curtis once “went out on to [their] windowsill… like Batman, inching like Batman” to get into the apartment of a recently deceased neighbor to steal her clothes before the coroner came. It’s these sorts of tangents that make No Dogs in Space so compelling. “We live our lives in like a state of obsession,” Parks said. “Obsession really is, it is kind of our superpower. And we were both recently diagnosed with autism and discovered that that’s just who we are. That’s the superpower that we get.“ If you’re wondering where to start, the new series on the New York Dolls is as good as any. The Dolls were a protopunk and glam act that played an important role in building the NYC scene. But I also can’t recommend the series on the Replacements, Dead Kennedys, or Joy Division enough. You can listen to the new season of No Dogs in Space now on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or anywhere else you find fine podcasts. Or, for the first time, the show will be posted on YouTube as full video episodes.

Ware was booked on suspicion of misdemeanor battery after allegedly spraying the AMC Burbank 16 patron when he became upset over their in-theater etiquette, Burbank Police Department Lt. Brent Fekety said. The spray affected two other moviegoers, who were treated for their irritation at a local hospital, according to Fekety. Ware did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Sunday. It is unclear whether he has legal representation. Online, the incident has become another flashpoint in the ongoing debate among die-hard moviegoers, for whom putting away a phone is a basic rule of theater etiquette. Phone use in theaters has been a growing issue since pandemic restrictions were lifted. In recent years, as the box office rebounded into a Gen Z-driven boom, many moviegoers have lamented that the experience is now often tainted by fellow patrons’ full-volume conversations and persistent phone use. In February, Alamo Drafthouse, an Austin, Texas-based chain that built its identity in part on a strict no-phones policy, began requiring patrons to use their smartphones to order food and drinks during screenings. The policy reversal drew swift backlash from moviegoers, who saw it as at odds with the chain’s long-standing ethos. Last week’s pepper spray incident became social media fodder after Joe Rodriguez, who witnessed the incident, shared a post to a Reddit forum for people in the AMC A-list Stubs loyalty program. Rodriguez’s photos of Ware being handcuffed by police inside the theater recirculated on X and Instagram. His Reddit post about what he witnessed generated so much discussion that a moderator for the forum locked new comments in the thread, stating that users have “been down every rat-hole argument there [is] to have about this incident.” “Not cool to pepper spray,” wrote one Redditor. “Not cool to be on your phone during a movie. Both things true.” In a phone interview on Sunday, Rodriguez said the theater was less than an hour into a showing of “The Uprising” when he heard the hissing sound of a spray bottle going off. When he turned around, a man was covering his face with his hands while yelling that he got pepper-sprayed. “Everyone was kind of like, ‘Was that real? What just happened?’” Rodriguez said. “So I got up and I was like, ‘You know what? I’m just gonna go get like a staff member, let an employee know.’” Rodriguez, who was sitting in the row directly ahead of where the alleged altercation took place, said he saw Ware immediately run out of the theater. He was followed by three moviegoers who appeared intent on chasing after him. They soon found Ware lingering in the theater, and Rodriguez said he watched Ware defend himself to police during the arrest. “The thing that stuck out the most was him saying that the guy on the phone ‘got smart’ with him, and that led me to believe that this wasn’t self-defense or anything,” Rodriguez said. “This was just a guy who was frustrated and lashed out because a guy was being rude at the movies.” After the incident, Rodriguez said he spoke with the people who were exposed to secondhand spray in the theater. They said Ware had asked the patron he allegedly sprayed to turn off his device but that the person refused to do so. Rodriguez said he didn’t expect the incident to drive so much discussion, particularly from those who defended the pepper-spraying. He said he believes many online are “living vicariously through” the incident. “Because I’m sure in the moment, you want to lash out, and you’re like, ‘Oh, I want to teach this guy a lesson for being rude,’” Rodriguez said. “But ultimately what ended up happening is he kind of just ruined the movie for all those other people who got pepper spray on them, who had to go to the hospital, who had to do victim statements for people in the theater.” As an avid moviegoer and AMC A-Lister, Rodriguez said he understands people’s growing frustration with the erosion of traditional movie theater etiquette, especially with the influx of younger moviegoers who sometimes struggle to put their phones away. But people in Los Angeles, he said, seem to have a lower tolerance for poor manners in the theater. Perhaps, he said, it’s “kind of emblematic that this happened at the Burbank 16” — the most profitable theater in the country, frequented by entertainment industry types who take their moviegoing much more seriously. Still, he said, the pepper-spraying was a bizarre reaction to witness. “I deal with being behind the guy who’s on his phone, or behind the group of teenagers in the back of the theater who are constantly giggling and whispering to each other the whole movie, just being rude,” Rodriguez said. “You gotta choose your battles.”

articles.title: New Found Glory founder and guitarist Chad Gilbert dead at 45
articles.summary: New Found Glory guitarist Chad Gilbert died “peacefully in his sleep” Sunday morning at the age of 45, his bandmates and wife said in a statement.
articles.body: New Found Glory guitarist Chad Gilbert died “peacefully in his sleep” Sunday morning at the age of 45, his bandmates and wife said in a statement. “He left this world surrounded by friends and family and took his final breaths with his wife and mother by his side, just as he wished,” the band and Gilbert’s wife, Lisa Cimorelli, wrote on social media Sunday. “We are devastated and shocked by how quickly he left us, yet so grateful for how peacefully and smoothly he went.” The post did not disclose Gilbert’s cause of death. But the musician had been vocal about his cancer diagnoses, telling People magazine in April that he had been receiving treatment for adrenal cancer since 2021 and had also been diagnosed with Stage 4 adrenocortical carcinoma. Cimorelli told the outlet at the time that the additional prognosis allowed for “a much shorter lifespan than he’s already lived.” Gilbert continued to post updates for his fans on his personal Instagram page, including photos from hospital visits in recent months. New Found Glory, which Gilbert was a founding member of, was formed in Florida in 1997. The pop punk band is behind hits such as “My Friends Over You,” “Vicious Love,” “Stay Awhile” and “Ready and Willing.” Their most recent album, “Listen Up!” dropped in February. “Chad’s guitar playing, songwriting, humor, and relentless drive helped shape New Found Glory for nearly three decades,” the band wrote. “Through more than a dozen albums, endless tours around the world, and more accolades than we ever could have imagined, Chad challenged all of us to grow as musicians, performers, and human beings.” The group, which includes Jordan Pundik, Ian Grushka and Cyrus Bolooki, has been on tour in recent months, with two upcoming shows scheduled for October and November, including the Vans Warped Tour Orlando. After news of Gilbert’s death was announced, the tributes began to pour in on social media, with comments from fans and fellow artists, including Benjamin Madden and Joel Madden (of the band Good Charlotte) and musician-songwriter-producer Matthew Koma. “I’ve never seen anyone carry themselves through something like this with such positivity and strength,” the band Dashboard Confessional wrote. “What an example to us all. I’ll miss you so much Chad. RIP.” Bands the Offspring, Taking Back Sunday and the Ataris also shared their condolences. Gilbert is survived by his wife; his daughter, Lily; his mother, Jackie; and his brother, Brian, his bandmates said. “He was a legendary musician, but his favorite accomplishment was being a husband and father,” the band and Cimorelli’s social media statement said. “His biggest dreams came true.”

articles.title: Juliana Linhares ganha aval e 'xodó' de Anastácia em luminoso encontro de  realezas no show 'Até cansar o cansaço' | G1
articles.body:
Anastácia (à esquerda) participa da apresentação do show 'Até cansar o cansaço' feita por Juliana Linhares no Teatro da UFF, em Niterói (RJ), dentro do festival Interculturalidades — Foto: Rodrigo Goffredo

♬ Além de ter entronizado Juliana Linhares como uma das maiores artistas do Brasil pela força do canto teatral da artista potiguar, o show “Até cansar o cansaço” já se impôs como um dos melhores espetáculos feitos no país nos últimos tempos pela alta potência do conceito, do som e da interpretação da cantora e compositora, dona de performance repleta de gestos, inflexões e movimentos cênicos que valorizam o repertório e o vigor vocal de Juliana.

Na estrada desde 16 de julho, a turnê do show “Até cansar o cansaço” (2026) ganhou ponto adicional de luz na noite de ontem, 20 de setembro, em apresentação gratuita que encheu o Teatro da UFF, em Niterói (RJ), dentro da programação da 15ª edição do festival Interculturalidades.

A luminosidade suplementar veio da participação de Anastácia na apresentação. Nascida Lucinete Ferreira no Recife (PE), em 30 de maio de 1940, Anastácia é uma das rainhas da música nordestina. Residente na cidade de São Paulo (SP) desde os 20 anos, a artista está em cena há mais de seis décadas e, atualmente com 86 anos, preserva vitalidade contagiante.

A presença de Anastácia no show “Até cansar o cansaço” simbolizou um aval e xodó de rainha para Juliana Linhares, artista 50 anos mais nova – atualmente com 36 anos – que já ocupa lugar de honra na dinastia da música nordestina, parte fundamental da trilha sonora do Brasil.

Juliana Linhares já é uma rainha contemporânea dessa música popular e brasileira, ecoando, com forte assinatura própria, referências de Anastácia, da pioneira Marinês (1935 – 2007) e sobretudo de Elba Ramalho, cantora da qual Juliana é sucessora, inclusive por também ser atriz, como Elba.

Anastácia (à esquerda) e Juliana Linhares cantam músicas como 'Eu só quero um xodó' (1973) e 'Vida virada' (2026) no Teatro da UFF — Foto: Rodrigo Goffredo

No palco do Teatro da UFF, Anastácia e Juliana Linhares trocaram amabilidades e elogios, mas, como Anastácia, sublinhou, não foi mero confete , não. Havia ali uma admiração mútua, uma reverência sincera entre cantoras de diferentes gerações, mas que dialogam pela vivacidade rítmica da música da nação nordestina.

O encontro de realezas rendeu quatro números com Anastácia. O primeiro foi feito na pisada do baião “Vida virada” (Juliana Linhares, Josyara e Elisio Freitas, 2026), música que Juliana Linhares gravou com Anastácia no álbum “Até cansar o cansaço” (2026). Com alto astral, Anastácia brincou com o fato de ter se atrapalhado com a letra da música, completada por Juliana, sempre atenta aos sinais.

Na sequência, já sem precisar ler a letra escrita por ela mesma, Anastácia cantou “Sanfona sentida” (1973), primeira das três parcerias da artista com Dominguinhos (1941 – 2013) que entraram no roteiro da apresentação excepcional – em todos os sentidos – do show “Até cansar o cansaço” .

“Sanfona sentida” foi lançada em disco por Dominguinhos em registro instrumental feito para o obscuro álbum “Tudo azul” (1973). Mas coube a Luiz Gonzaga (1912 – 1989), rei vitalício da nação musical nordestina, apresentar há 50 anos a letra escrita por Anastácia em gravação feita para o álbum “Capim novo” (1976).

Em seguida, a cantora reviveu com Juliana as duas músicas mais populares da parceria de Anastácia com Dominguinhos, “Tenho sede” (1975) e o xote “Eu só quero um xodó” (1973), ambas apresentadas ao Brasil na voz de Gilberto Gil. Esses dois sucessos voltaram no bis, momento em que Juliana Linhares deu literalmente flores em vida para Anastácia.

O bis estendeu o encontro luminoso e significativo de Juliana Linhares com Anastácia, cantoras que, em diferentes épocas e gerações, pagaram para ver a liberdade de serem rainhas da própria vida e da própria música, vivendo a vida virada na estrada e acendendo fogueiras nos cantos que doem .

articles.title: Curta potiguar 'Mariposa' é premiado em Festival de Brasília | G1
articles.standfirst: Filme gravado em Extremoz foi premiado como melhor curta pelo Prêmio Zózimo Bulbul e também recebeu menção honrosa do júri oficial.
articles.summary: Curta potiguar “Mariposa”, gravado em Extremoz, venceu o Prêmio Zózimo Bulbul e recebeu menção honrosa no Festival de Brasília.
articles.body:
Curta potiguar 'Mariposa' vence prêmio — Foto: Júlia Tolentino

O curta-metragem potiguar “Mariposa” , dirigido por Alexandre Américo e Pedro Vitor, recebeu dois reconhecimentos na 59ª edição do Festival de Brasília do Cinema Brasileiro. O filme venceu o Prêmio Zózimo Bulbul de melhor curta e recebeu uma menção honrosa do júri oficial da Mostra Competitiva Nacional de Curtas.

Os vencedores foram anunciados neste sábado (19), no Cine Brasília. “Mariposa” foi um dos 12 filmes selecionados para a Mostra Competitiva Nacional, entre quase 2 mil obras inscritas. O curta fez sua estreia durante o festival.

O Prêmio Zózimo Bulbul é concedido por um júri indicado pelo Centro Afrocarioca de Cinema e pela Associação dos Profissionais do Audiovisual Negro (APAN). A premiação reconhece produções que contribuem para a presença e a valorização das narrativas e perspectivas negras no cinema brasileiro.

Na avaliação do júri, “Mariposa” apresenta “inventividade dentro do território ancestral”, com a criação de signos e significados próprios e o afastamento de estereótipos relacionados às representações da população negra.

Ao receber o prêmio, Alexandre Américo destacou a relação da obra com a criação de novas narrativas e imagens sobre a população negra.

“Esse prêmio especialmente reflete o quanto nós estamos comprometidos em fabular e inventar outras narrativas e outras imagens, descoladas dessas imagens fixadas do que pode um negro produzir, do que pode uma comunidade negra produzir, do que pode a negritude produzir. Então acho que esse prêmio nos reconhece e nos aponta que estamos num caminho necessário”, afirmou.

Além do Prêmio Zózimo Bulbul, “Mariposa” recebeu uma menção honrosa do júri oficial da Mostra Competitiva Nacional. O reconhecimento considerou a articulação entre fotografia, montagem e som na abordagem da vivência e da resistência de um território.

O curta foi gravado nas dunas da praia de Santa Rita, em Extremoz , no Rio Grande do Norte.

Para o diretor Pedro Vitor, a premiação também reconhece o processo de pesquisa e produção artística desenvolvido por pessoas negras e pessoas com deficiência, além do compromisso político da obra produzida pela Torta Plataforma.

“Essa Menção Honrosa também diz muito, para nós, desse senso de dever de inventar um mundo onde o capitalismo já destruiu. Então é um compromisso, antes de tudo político, que esse prêmio nos devolve, nos reconhece”, pontuou.

“Mariposa” tem 14 minutos, é filmado em preto e branco e aproxima temas como memória, rito, natureza e território.

A história apresenta Dona Zefa, interpretada por Mãe Bianca de Omolú, e Oliveira, vivido por Alexandre Américo, como personagens encantados ligados ao território de Santa Rita.

Curta potiguar 'Mariposa' é selecionado para Festival de Brasília — Foto: Divulgação

O filme surgiu a partir do encontro entre Alexandre Américo e Pedro Vitor e da aproximação de Pedro com o universo das encantarias, da Jurema Sagrada e das religiosidades de terreiro do Candomblé.

A produção foi realizada com recursos da Lei Paulo Gustavo e tem distribuição da Ebó Filmes, de Rosy Nascimento. Entre as referências utilizadas na obra estão itãs, contos e narrativas transmitidos em rodas, xirês e rituais do Candomblé.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran says friends and family ‘ABANDONED’ him amid Macklemore controversy: 'Had so many people telling me to cancel this tour'

articles.body: Ed Sheeran has been in the headines since moving ahead with his Loop Tour at Philadelphia’s Lincoln Financial Field on Saturday night amid much controversy following the removal of rapper Macklemore. The controversy has since seen all of Sheeran’s scheduled opening acts, as well as his touring band, withdraw from the tour in solidarity with Macklemore.Ed Sheeran on feeling 'abandoned' by familySpeaking to the 50,000-strong crowd, Sheeran was seen getting rather emotional and breaking down several times while addressing the audience. During the candid chat with the crowd, the actor said the past week had made him reassess some of his closest relationships after his members of his family and friends' cricle 'abandoned' him.In a video captured by a fan, the singer said, "In these situations you really find out who your friends are. It’s been a weird week. It happened very quickly. At the same time, I had so many people telling me to cancel this tour and so many people I’ve known for years and years and years they’re kind of backing away.""In the back of my mind, I saw the ticket sales for this gig and I didn’t see cancellations; I saw people buying tickets for this gig,” he continued as the crowd cheered. "Everyone’s telling me to cancel and I’m feeling all of my friends and family and people I know abandon me."Ed Sheeran's cousin claims singer is 'not a good person'Although the singer did not identify which family members he was referring to, fans noted that his cousin, Jethro Sheeran publicly criticised him on social media amid the fallout. Jethro wrote, "Finally it’s all coming out! I’m ashamed of my cousin Ed he’s done. Finally the world and all his fans see through him. He’s not a good person, I don’t like his music so I can’t say he’s even a good artist."He also wrote, "He’s honestly a selfish individual with malicious, cunning ways… I’m his first blood cousin and he screwed me over, made fun of my mental health and mental health in general."Ed Sheeran gets emotional as fans show him their supportDespite the backlash, Sheeran said he chose to continue performing for his fans. “I look at the end of the week and I see 50,000 people who haven’t abandoned me,” he told the audience. “People will say what they want, but I am doing this for you. I love you. I love this.”Sheeran also acknowledged that he changed the stage layout. Explaining the reason for the same was owing to security concerns, he said, "I apologize that today is not the usual Loop show. And I will admit that."Ed Sheeran calls solo gig his 'best show'Sheeran described the Philadelphia concert as the “best show” of his life, while calling the preceding week one of the worst he had experienced. He later broke down in tears while speaking about the support he received from the audience, admitting that he had initially been concerned about how the crowd would react."The world is a scary place right now, America is a scary place right now," he said, before pointing towards the audience and adding, "This gives hope."The emotional concert came amid continuing fallout over Macklemore’s removal from the Loop Tour. Sheeran previously said that the decision to drop the rapper as one of his opening acts, was not his and that he had attempted to mediate between the rapper, promoters and venues. The controversy intensified after Macklemore was removed following pro-Palestinian comments made during his performances, prompting Finneas, Lukas Graham, Aaron Rowe and Beoga to withdraw from the tour.Sheeran’s next scheduled performances are on September 25 and 26 at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.summary: In 2019, Oprah Winfrey bought a four-acre Spanish Revival property in Montecito from actor Jeff Bridges for $6.85 million, folding it into her sprawli.
articles.body: In 2019, Oprah Winfrey bought a four-acre Spanish Revival property in Montecito from actor Jeff Bridges for $6.85 million, folding it into her sprawling "Promised Land" estate near Santa Barbara, California. Six years later, in late 2025, she quietly sold that same four-acre parcel for $17.2 million to Maroon 5 frontman Adam Levine and his wife, the supermodel Behati Prinsloo, as reported by Robb Report, more than doubling her original investment while still holding on to the rest of her roughly 66-acre Montecito compound today.Oprah Winfrey's purchase of the Montecito Estate from Jeff BridgesJeff Bridges and his wife, Susan Geston, had owned the century-old ranch since 2014, restoring it after mudslide damage before listing it for sale. They initially sought close to $8 million.Winfrey, whose primary "Promised Land" estate sits next door in Montecito's Hedgerow District, ultimately secured the home for $6.85 million in 2019, slightly less than Bridges's asking price. The purchase extended her existing compound, which she began assembling in 2001 and, per Robb Report, later expanded in 2015 with the neighbouring Seamair Farm, to roughly 70 acres in total.Inside Winfrey's four-acre Spanish property in MontecitoThe single-level main house, built in 1919 by architect James Osborn Craig, spans about 3,500 square feet with two bedrooms and four bathrooms. Formal living and dining rooms are anchored by five fireplaces, with beamed ceilings, hardwood floors, and oversized windows throughout. The primary suite includes dual walk-in closets and an ensuite bathroom with heated teak floors, a soaking tub, and a glass-enclosed shower. French doors open onto a brick patio with a fire pit. The grounds also feature a pool and spa, a guesthouse, a poolhouse, a carriage house, and equestrian stables.Oprah Winfrey sold the Montecito Estate for $17.2 millionWinfrey sold the four-acre parcel off-market in late 2025 for $17.2 million, according to Architectural Digest, which credited local outlet Sightline Santa Barbara as having first reported the deal. The buyers were identified as Maroon 5 singer Adam Levine and his wife, model Behati Prinsloo, according to Robb Report, who purchased the property without it ever being publicly listed for sale.The sale came roughly three years after Winfrey sold a separate Montecito property, the former Shuman estate, to actress Jennifer Aniston for $14.8 million in 2022. Even after parting with the Bridges parcel, Winfrey retains more than 60 acres of her original "Promised Land" estate in the Hedgerow District of Montecito.What the $17.2 million sale means for Oprah's real estate portfolioThe sale netted Winfrey a profit of roughly $10.35 million after six years of ownership, more than doubling the $6.85 million she originally paid Bridges back in 2019. It marks the latest in a series of adjustments to her real estate holdings, which are estimated at around $150 million, spanning her Montecito compound, roughly 1,000 acres in Hawaii, and a ski chalet in Telluride, Colorado.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.body: Presley Gerber, the son of supermodel Cindy Crawford and businessman Rande Gerber, has sadly passed away at the age of 27.According to TMZ, Presley breathed his last on Sunday, September 20, at a rehabilitation facility, according to records from the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner.Cindy Crawford and family ask for privacy following Presley Gerber's deathA representative for Cindy Crawford, Rande Gerber and their daughter, model and actress Kaia Gerber, confirmed the family is grieving the loss and issued a statement that read, "The family is asking for privacy during this very difficult and painful time."As per the report, an autopsy and official cause of death has not yet been confirmed.Born in Beverly Hills in 1999, Presley followed in his mother's footsteps and became a model. Over the years, Presley became increasingly vocal about his mental health journey and has been advocating for the cause to help others facing similar struggles.Presley Gerber on struggle with mental healthSpeaking on the Studio 22 podcast, he said, "Having struggled with mental health, depression and some other things that come along with that, I think that whether I help one person or a hundred people get out of that place that I was in at one point in my life, that’s all I need to do.""[Mental health] is an issue. articles.summary: En un mundo en el que el ritmo de vida ya nos ha quitado hasta el tiempo de lo más necesario y primario en una persona como es el sentarse a comer, los chefs y expertos en cocina ya no cuentan sus recetas más elaboradas. Ahora dan trucos para cocinar saludable y rico en apenas unos minutos.
articles.body: En un mundo en el que el ritmo de vida ya nos ha quitado hasta el tiempo de lo más necesario y primario en una persona como es el sentarse a comer, los chefs y expertos en cocina ya no cuentan sus recetas más elaboradas. Ahora dan trucos para cocinar saludable y rico en apenas unos minutos. Julius Bienert es un ejemplo de ellos. El chef ha explicado en su canal de YouTube ‘Go! Julius’ cómo preparar unas patatas cocidas al microondas. Mientras que algunos expertos recomiendan no hacer uso de este electrodoméstico, Bienert sale en su defensa para poder salvarnos de algún apuro y no tirar de comida preparada. “La patata cocida en el microondas mejora muchísimo en textura y no se reseca si se aplica aceite de oliva y se envuelve en papel film durante 7 minutos a potencia máxima", explica el chef. Si bien, asegura que para eso primero hay que seguir unos pasos que serán determinantes para obtener el resultado deseado. Primero hay que pintarlas con aceite de oliva y sal, luego se pinchan varias veces y a continuación, llega el paso más importante: envolverlas en papel film. Con este truco ayudamos a conservar la humedad de la patata durante la cocción. Al estar envuelta, el vapor genera que la propia patata permanezca intacta y evita que esta se reseque. Una vez en el microondas se cocinan durante 7 minutos a 200ºC para conseguir ese dorado final. Una vez estén listas, puedes utilizarlas en tus platos como más guste. Se pueden rellenar, hacer una ensalada, como guarnición... Lo importante es que en menos de 10 minutos podemos disfrutar de uno de los alimentos más ricos de la cocina y disfrutar de un plato sano sin necesidad de recurrir a la comida rápida.

articles.title: Carlos Bardem señala el silencio de los futbolistas: "Estadísticamente es imposible que no haya futbolistas gays y ninguno sale a decirlo"
articles.standfirst: El actor y escritor habla de su pasión por el Atlético, critica la transformación del fútbol y reclama mayor implicación social a los futbolistas
articles.summary: El actor y escritor habla de su pasión por el Atlético, critica la transformación del fútbol y reclama mayor implicación social a los futbolistas
articles.body: Carlos Bardem es un reconocido aficionado al fútbol y, especialmente, al Atlético de Madrid. El actor y escritor, que acaba de estrenar 'En la zona gris', la película dirigida por Guy Ritchie, habló con MARCA sobre su relación con el deporte, la transformación que ha experimentado el fútbol en los últimos años y el papel que, a su juicio, deberían desempeñar los futbolistas más allá del terreno de juego. Preguntado por lo que significa para él el Atlético, Bardem lo tiene claro: "El Atleti para mí significa lo que ha significado siempre: rebeldía". El actor recuerda que creció en Madrid rodeado mayoritariamente de seguidores del Real Madrid y que, desde pequeño, ser del conjunto rojiblanco le generaba una sensación de pertenencia diferente. "Soy de Madrid y, cuando era pequeño, iba al colegio y todos los niños eran del Madrid, salvo uno o dos que éramos del Atleti", explica. Una identificación que, según cuenta, le hizo asociar al club con una determinada forma de entender el fútbol. Bardem también se muestra muy crítico con la evolución que ha experimentado el deporte. "Odio eterno al fútbol moderno", afirma durante la entrevista. El actor reconoce que el fútbol siempre ha sido un negocio y que entiende su dimensión como espectáculo, pero considera que la transformación económica ha alterado su esencia. "El fútbol cada vez tiene menos de competición y más de espectáculo guionizado", sostiene. En su opinión, la creciente monetización está alejando a las aficiones de los clubes. Pone como ejemplos el precio de las entradas y de las camisetas y relaciona este fenómeno con una progresiva gentrificación de las ciudades y de los propios estadios. "Nuestras ciudades, los campos de fútbol y las competiciones se están convirtiendo en parques temáticos para turistas con dinero", señala. Para Bardem, esta transformación hace que se pierda una de las características que considera fundamentales del fútbol: el sentimiento de pertenencia y la relación entre los aficionados y sus equipos. Su crítica al fútbol actual también alcanza a la dimensión social de sus protagonistas. Bardem considera que los futbolistas cuentan con una plataforma pública especialmente importante y que deberían utilizarla para dar visibilidad a determinadas realidades. En ese sentido, pone el foco en la homosexualidad dentro del fútbol profesional. "Estadísticamente es imposible que no haya futbolistas gays y ninguno sale a decirlo", afirma. El actor considera significativo que, pese al número de profesionales que participan en el fútbol de élite, no haya apenas futbolistas que hagan pública su homosexualidad. "Cuando hay un colectivo en el que es imposible estadísticamente que no haya cierto tipo de personas y esas personas nunca se las ve, no tienen voz o están condenadas a callarse, creo que eso es significativo", explica. Bardem relaciona esta situación con el peso económico que rodea al fútbol profesional y con la posible incomodidad que determinados posicionamientos pueden generar en torno a patrocinadores y negocios. Precisamente, el actor acaba de participar en 'No lo grites', una película rodada en Argentina que aborda esta cuestión. En ella interpreta a un agente de futbolistas y la historia gira alrededor de un joven con potencial para convertirse en una gran estrella del fútbol que es gay. La película plantea el conflicto entre cumplir su sueño deportivo y la posibilidad de que tenga que ocultar su identidad para conseguirlo.

articles.title: Javier Aguado, experto en arroces: "El gran error al hacer una paella en casa es no añadir el caldo hirviendo"
articles.standfirst: Explica los tres errores más habituales al preparar una paella y cómo evitarlos para conseguir un arroz en su punto
articles.summary: Explica los tres errores más habituales al preparar una paella y cómo evitarlos para conseguir un arroz en su punto
articles.body: Preparar una buena paella en casa parece sencillo, pero hay varios errores durante la cocción que pueden cambiar por completo el resultado final. Javier Aguado, cocinero y rostro visible del restaurante Arroz2 de Toledo, especializado en arroces junto a su hermano Andrés, ha señalado algunos de los fallos más habituales que se cometen al preparar este plato. Entre ellos hay uno especialmente importante y que tiene que ver con la temperatura del caldo que se incorpora a la paella. "El segundo gran error que solemos cometer muchas veces es no añadir el caldo caliente o hirviendo. Eso provoca un corte en la cocción del grano y fastidiamos la paella", explica el cocinero. La temperatura del líquido es, por tanto, uno de los aspectos que Aguado considera fundamentales durante la elaboración del arroz. Incorporarlo caliente o hirviendo permite mantener las condiciones de cocción del grano, mientras que añadirlo a una temperatura inferior puede alterar ese proceso. El caldo no es, sin embargo, el único punto en el que hay que prestar atención. Aguado también señala un gesto muy habitual cuando se prepara una paella en casa: remover continuamente el arroz. "Durante un tiempo no se puede tocar. Al principio sí, pero luego hay que parar de moverlo", explica. Según el cocinero, manipular el arroz de manera constante durante la cocción afecta a la textura del grano y favorece la liberación de almidón. La recomendación pasa por repartir inicialmente los ingredientes y el arroz, pero dejar después que el grano continúe su cocción sin estar moviéndolo de manera constante. Aguado apunta además a un tercer elemento que suele pasar desapercibido: el reposo. Una vez terminada la cocción, considera importante dejar que el arroz repose antes de servirlo. "Todo arroz necesita tiempo de reposo para que termine caramelizando", señala. Los consejos del cocinero se pueden resumir, por tanto, en tres cuestiones: no añadir el caldo frío, no mover continuamente el arroz y respetar el tiempo de reposo. Aguado desarrolla estos consejos desde su experiencia al frente de Arroz2, restaurante de Toledo que dirige junto a su hermano Andrés y cuya propuesta gastronómica tiene los arroces como una de sus especialidades. Entre sus elaboraciones se encuentran arroces como el de pulpo, el arroz negro o el de carabineros.

articles.title: Dance sessions for people with dementia Buckingham Palace
articles.summary: The programme's sessions have been designed and delivered by English National Ballet.
articles.body:
Buckingham Palace has hosted a special series of dance workshops for people living with dementia.

The programme has been organised by Royal Collection Trust and the charity Arts for Dementia, with sessions designed and delivered by English National Ballet (ENB).

Director of engagement at ENB, Fleur Derbyshire-Fox said dance was not only about cognitive benefits "but also about the physical, emotional and social benefit".

"Being in Buckingham Palace has such resonance for the people who come to these classes. It's a rich tapestry - looking at the royal collections and being in this space. It's really inspiring for the participants."

Four sessions are taking place as part of the programme, with the same group of 20 participants returning to the palace for each one.

Amy Stocker, from the Royal Collection Trust said the sense of recognition can make the palace particularly meaningful.

"They recognise the building as an iconic landmark. They might have been at the front of the palace to watch the royal family appear on the balcony.

"People have a connection to his majesty the King, they remember Queen Elizabeth.

"For the older generation there is a connection to the monarchy and that often sparks something when you bring them to a place like this."

Naseem Malik-Noor, who lives in Westminster, said she loved the royal family and had been excited to attend the workshop with her niece.

"I like the way things were explained and every one was so accommodating and kind which is very important."

She said the palace was "beautiful" and "outstanding."

Her niece, Sasha De Medici, said they both enjoyed the day: "With the music and the ballet it's so special and we're very privileged to have been able to take part."

The sessions coincided with World Alzheimer's Month, which takes place every September to raise awareness of dementia and highlight the support available to those affected by it.

Arts for Dementia offers regular, free, inspiring programmes like the one at Buckingham Palace, which the charity said helped people living with dementia "build confidence, maintain their identity, create new social connections and experience a sense of self-purpose".

articles.title: Actor Will Mellor beaten in Cumbria world gurning championships
articles.summary: The World Gurning Championship is held annually in the small Cumbrian town of Egremont.
articles.body:
Actor Will Mellor has come a surprise second in the World Gurning Championships, pipped to the main prize by local man Ged Eccles who had come close but never before won.

Part of the annual Egremont Crab Fair in Cumbria, which began in 1267, the gurning competition has been a fixture since the 1500s. Competitors are judged on their ability to pull the ugliest or most grotesque face.

The Hollyoaks and Mr Bates vs The Post Office star won second place in the men's competition after attending as part of a programme he was filming.

Eccles said he felt "ecstatic" to have finally won the men's competition. It was his first victory since becoming the junior champion in 1985.

He came second in 2023 and was third in 2016 and 2009 and said he believed he had won this year because of the extra practice he had put in.

"I practise in front of a mirror for maybe three to four hours a day," he said. "I've been doing that since the end of May."

He said he did this to loosen up his neck, cheekbone and jaw bone muscles in order to get his lip on to his nose. "And that's what I did," he said.

Eccles said he hoped to defend his title next year and that he planned to continue gurning "until the day I can't do it anymore".

One of the event's organisers, Dan Nixon, said it was good to see Eccles finally win.

He said there were about 50 entrants to the men's, women's and junior versions of the competition and that up to 800 people had attended.

"I think everyone in Egremont takes part in the Crab Fair in some way," he said.

Local woman Claire Lister won the women's competition again after losing her crown last year.

The nine-time champion said: "I'm absolutely delighted to have won again, I'm really proud and it still feels just as special every time.

"It's just a bit of fun and keeps the Egremont Crab Fair tradition going."

Lister said she does not train or practise for the competition but just turns up on the day and gives it her best.

"I think after doing it for so many years it just comes naturally to me now," she said.

Nixon described her as "a seasoned winner".

The competition's organising committee have already started planning next year's event which will be its 760th.

"We're very much hoping that it's going to be a really, really big spectacular," he said.
